thread:
Sam (partnerships): hey team - vendor asked for our compliance bundle for listing review (SOC2 + pen test report + completed marketplace questionnaire). timeline is 'asap' but we have a few constraints. who should own packaging and delivery?
Priya (security): we can own redaction and presigned link generation. quick Q: will the partner need long-term access or just a one-time download?
Sam (partnerships): one-time download preferred by partner, but platform reviewers may come back. partner asked for 30 days access.
Darren (legal): we need to strip customer data and any supporting logs that include PII. also confirm the NDA covers sharing pen-test findings with the marketplace.
Priya (security): agreed. plan: 1) create a redacted SOC2 snapshot 2) generate a presigned S3 bundle valid 30 days 3) provide an index.md with checklist of included docs + redaction notes 4) enable S3 access logging and TTL.
Ivy (integration): I can stand up the temp bucket and upload. prefer naming: redacted-compliance-bundle/<marketplace>/<date>/bundle.zip. will set lifecycle to auto-delete after 35 days.
Sam (partnerships): perfect. can we include a short README for reviewers explaining what was redacted and where to find scope statements? they sometimes ask.
Priya (security): yes. README will include: what was removed (examples), who to contact for questions, and the report version. we should also include hash of the bundle for integrity.
Darren (legal): confirm we include a minimal statement that the bundle is shared under our standard NDA and that further distribution is restricted. Priya, can you add that line?
Priya (security): will do. also: redaction pipeline notes: remove customer names, obfuscate IPs, remove full log excerpts. keep control plane screenshots but crop usernames.
MarketplaceBot: notice: new marketplace submission ticket #MP-421 created by Sam. (auto-msg)
Ivy (integration): upload ETA: today EOD. presigned link format is: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-temp/redacted-compliance-bundle/marketplaceX/2026-05-12/bundle.zip?X-Amz-Signature=...
Sam (partnerships): timeline check — partner review expected within 2 weeks. can we add a canary access token if they need to re-request?
Priya (security): we can add an extension flow: partner emails partnerships@redwood.com, we review request, and if OK we generate a new link (audit trail preserved). that keeps control.
Darren (legal): recommend we also track who downloaded and keep logs for 90 days in case of disputes. Ops may keep short-term logs but we'll export a signed statement if needed.
Ivy (integration): logs will be saved to internal S3: s3://redwood-compliance-access-logs/marketplaceX/2026-05. retention 90 days as requested.
Sam (partnerships): assign owners: partnerships = Sam; security = Priya (redaction + approvals); legal = Darren (clauses); infra = Ivy (upload + logs). I'll update the marketplace ticket with owners and timeline.
Priya (security): I'll draft the README and redaction notes and post them here once done. planning to finish by tomorrow noon.
Ivy (integration): I'll do the upload and link generation after Priya's README. target: EOD tomorrow for delivery to partner.
Sam (partnerships): thanks all. quick checklist before we close: redaction complete, README included, presigned link (30d), access logging enabled, retention and extension process documented, legal statement added.
Priya (security): checkboxed. will ping when ready. :white_check_mark:
Darren (legal): will review README for legal language once Priya posts it.
MarketplaceBot: ticket #MP-421 updated: owners assigned, ETA 48h. (auto-msg)
Sam (partnerships): great — closing thread for now, will reopen if partner asks for more. thanks! :rocket:
